scene_description: Two adjacent wire publication racks beside a glass entrance door. The upper-right shelf holds a thick newspaper stack, the middle-right shelf holds red magazines, and the lower-left shelf holds white-covered magazines.

targets.name: newspaper stack
targets.description: Thick stack of folded publications with dark blue-green cover bands on the top shelf of the right-hand rack, above the red magazines.
targets.clearance_notes: Top and front are exposed, but the stack is set back from the front shelf rail and side rails constrain lateral access.

candidate_improvements.description: Move the whole newspaper stack approximately 8 cm toward the front of its shelf while keeping it fully supported behind the front rail.

targets.other_notes: Target and dimensions refer to the entire newspaper stack, not a single publication. The visible upper and lower bundles are treated together.

targets.name: red magazine stack
targets.description: Stack of red Judicature magazines on the middle shelf of the right rack, directly below the newspaper stack.
targets.clearance_notes: Front edges and much of the top are exposed. The rack restricts some side and overhead approaches, but a front approach remains open.
targets.other_notes: Dimensions refer to the complete 21.5 x 28 x 5.5 cm stack. No obvious repositioning is needed for general access; rack constraints depend on the intended approach.

targets.name: white magazine stack
targets.description: Stack of white-covered magazines with a dark head silhouette and red lower bands on the lower shelf of the left rack, below the blue Chronicle sign.
targets.clearance_notes: Front and top of the stack are visible, with space above it. Rails restrict some approach directions, but the front remains accessible.
targets.other_notes: Dimensions refer to the complete 21.5 x 28 x 3.5 cm stack. Target excludes the separate newspaper visible farther back on another shelf.
